traits.label: Hymenium
traits.text: Gills crowded, narrow; whitish to cream when young, becoming cream-ochre to yellowish

traits.text: Convex when young, later flat to centrally depressed; dry, matte, finely pruinose to velvety; pale ochre, grey-brown to smoky brown, often irregularly paler toward margin; unzoned

traits.raw: ℹ️ Stipe: Cylindrical, often tapering toward base; initially white to whitish, later cream-grey; smooth to finely pruinose; becoming hollow with age

traits.label: Spore print

observations.caption:
👇 …
🆔 Lactarius azonites (Bull.) Fr.
🍄 Russulaceae / Russulales / Agaricomycetes

🇺🇸 Zoneless Milkcap
🇩🇪 Rauchfarbener Milchling
🇫🇮 Tammensavurousku  
🇪🇪 Hall riisikas
🇷🇺 Млечник беззоновый

🗓️ 19/Sep/2026, 3:42 PM 
🌡️ 17°C 🌥️ Mostly cloudy 💨 Wind 220° SW->NE, 28 km/h
🌎 Nedrema LKA, Pärnu county, Eesti  
📌 58°32'18.2"N 24°04'20.1"E
🌳💧🍂🍃 Wooded meadow nature reserve, under oak, birch, aspen trees, in grassy calcareous soil with decaying leaves remains

ℹ️ Hymenium: Gills crowded, narrow; whitish to cream when young, becoming cream-ochre to yellowish
ℹ️ Cap: Convex when young, later flat to centrally depressed; dry, matte, finely pruinose to velvety; pale ochre, grey-brown to smoky brown, often irregularly paler toward margin; unzoned
ℹ️ Hymenium Attachment: Adnate to slightly decurrent
ℹ️ Stipe: Cylindrical, often tapering toward base; initially white to whitish, later cream-grey; smooth to finely pruinose; becoming hollow with age
⚪🟡🟠🔴 Spore print pale cream to ochre, sometimes pinkish-buff
🌳🍂 Mycorrhizal with hardwoods, especially oak and chestnut, also beech; deciduous forests, parks and woodland edges, on calcareous soil; scattered to gregariously; summer to autumn
😒 Edibility disputed, taste becoming acrid
📏 Fruit body small to medium; stipe ~3–7 cm long and ~0.5–1.5 cm thick
📐 Cap ∅ ~3–8 cm
🔪 Whitish to cream, brittle, turning salmon-pink to pink-orange within minutes when cut; abundant white latex also stains gills and flesh pink but remains white when isolated
🧪 Guaiac rapidly blue-green; KOH negative on flesh and latex; FeSO₄ weak to nearly negative
👃 Faint, pleasantly fruity, coconut-like
👅 Mild initially, then slightly bitter to acrid
🔬 Spores globose to subglobose, ~7–9 × 6–8.5 µm, ornamented with amyloid warts and ridges; basidia 4-spored; cheilomacrocystidia abundant, fusiform with elongated necks; pileipellis a trichoderm
🔤 Pale unzoned milkcap with white stipe and characteristic salmon-pinking flesh

🎞️ MF, ISO 1250, 1/200s, ƒ/10
💡 Shade from trees
🎨 Lightroom, IrfanView
🖼️ 24MP (RAW), 3:2, no crop
📖 6 photos, various views

📷 Sony α7 III (ILCE-7M3)
🔭 Sony FE 50mm F2.8 Macro (SEL50M28)
